method: dsan_lambda0_target_pass (LMMD weight 0, target windows pass through the model)
optimizer: Adam (torch.optim.Adam, L2 weight decay, default betas)

lmmd.bandwidth: mean squared distance over all pairs of the stacked batch, no gradient
lmmd.pseudo_labels: softmax outputs of the model on the target batch of the step, no gradient

target_input: target train windows only (features.pkl), no labels
forward_passes: separate source and target passes in train mode, source first

adatime.weights: configs/hparams.py:56-62 (class HAR = UCIHAR, 'DSAN'); the loss uses domain_loss_wt, mmd_wt is not read by DSAN

nondeterminism: Trained on Apple MPS. PyTorch does not guarantee bitwise reproducible results on MPS; a repeated run with the same seed can differ slightly.
